summary: Full backend + frontend validation for iter107 Athlete Scouting changes: (1) Bulk Skill Upload (CSV/XLSX template + import with alias/clamp/dedupe/invalid handling) and (2) Scouting-report SELECTION model (coach sees all, athlete/parent see only skills with a level set). All 7 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend: /team/scouting-skills renders skill library with skills-template-btn + skills-import-btn testIDs; /team/scouting-report as coach shows every library skill with a muted 'Add' dashed chip, tapping opens the edit modal, unselected shows 'Add to report' with no Remove button, choosing a progression level (spotted) + Save flips the button to 'Save assessment' and reveals 'Remove from report' (testID scouting-remove-btn). Level clearing (level:'') hides the skill from parent/athlete views as verified via the backend PUT + GET flow. No React Native red screens or deprecated packages found.

issues: Tapping the download-template icon triggers an Alert.alert with 3 buttons (CSV/Excel/Cancel). React Native Web renders multi-button Alerts as an on-screen picker on RN-Web >=0.19 but here no chooser appeared on web preview (window.alert fallback is silent). On iOS/Android this works natively. Not blocking mobile shipping.

action_items: Optional: on web, replace Alert.alert(3 buttons) chooser in scouting-skills.tsx onTemplatePress with an inline modal (or a Platform.OS==='web' branch) so the CSV/XLSX picker is usable in the web preview. Native mobile is fine.

Cosmetic: cleared skills retain their coach `notes` (backend only unsets level when level:'' is sent). The UI shows an old note on unselected skills (e.g. 'iter107 test note' stayed after clear). Consider clearing notes when the level is removed, or hide notes when !s.level.
Optional: consider adding testIDs for the CSV/Excel chooser options and for the empty-state to enable stronger UI regression coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: scouting.py: _report_payload include_all correctly filters out skills without an athlete-side level for parent/athlete/public shares (line 111-112). Selection model implemented via the same PUT endpoint — set level to add, empty string clears. Verified end-to-end.

scouting.py import: category aliases (Tumble/Stunt/Jump), level clamp 1-7, dedupe on (category, level, normalized name), and per-key auto-order increment all work correctly. Existing library seeded (216 skills) is respected — no accidental duplication observed.
Template endpoint properly sets Content-Disposition attachment for both CSV and XLSX. CSV first line is exactly 'Category,Level,Skill Name' as required.
scouting-skills.tsx: uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for both template download and import upload, correctly attaches Bearer token, handles web-vs-native FormData for the multipart upload.

scouting-report.tsx: coach unselected skills correctly styled with skillCardMuted (opacity 0.6, bg swap), and addChip renders dashed border with 'Add' label as spec'd. save button label switches on !!edit?.level; remove-btn only rendered for selected skills.
seed_data_creation: During tests, 3 skills (TEST_iter107_ScoutSkill_A, _B, _XlsxJump_C) were briefly added to the demo coach household and then removed via _cleanup_iter107.py. Also toggled a 'spotted' level with note 'iter107 test note' on Ava Johnson's Forward roll skill; the level was cleared at the end of the frontend test (note text may persist by design — see action item).
